anchor_note: 3.0 is exactly representable in this rung; it decodes to exactly 3 with no rounding error.
format_notes: S1 E18 M29, BIAS=131071 (=2^(E-1)-1, IEC 60559 interchange bias). Storage word: u64_padded; vectors use the FORMAT bit-width 48, not the storage word. Decode law shared across all five rungs; promoted to strict SW-bitexact by an INDEPENDENT second decoder (gf_wide_independent_witness.py, dyadic-exact, abs_error=0). PHI_BIAS is OPEN/RETRACTED per the spec and is NOT emitted; phi_distance is descriptive metadata only, never used in decode.
governing_sentence: The GoldenFloat ladder earns its place through breadth and toolchain coherence, NOT through per-rung superiority over any competitor format. Takum (Hunhold 2024, arXiv:2412.20273) is the standing counterexample and is not suppressed.
structural_reason: Bit-precise round-trip defined; vectors emitted by encoder and confirmed by an INDEPENDENT second decoder (gf_wide_independent_witness.py, dyadic A*2^B exact comparison, abs_error=0), plus a golden Fraction oracle and a fixed-width FP64 RTL bit-model (224255/224255 vs golden). Strict bitexact, not selfconsistent. See the witnesses array.

witnesses.decoder: gf_wide_independent_witness.py (from-scratch dyadic normalizer, odd*2^shift; does NOT reuse the encoder)
witnesses.note: Independent second decoder distinct from the software encoder that produced these vectors. This is the in-repo witness that promotes gf48 from selfconsistent to strict bitexact. SW-only; not an on-silicon HW-conformance (Tier-E) claim.
witnesses.result: 15/15 bit-exact vs golden, abs_error=0 [e=18 m=29 bias=131071]
witnesses.scope: all 15 pack vectors (dyadic A*2^B exact comparison)

witnesses.decoder: gf48_decode_ref.py (fractions.Fraction exact oracle -> IEEE binary64, RNE)
witnesses.note: Third independent decode path (exact rational arithmetic) agreeing with the dyadic witness. SW-only.
witnesses.scope: all 15 pack vectors + FP64 target lowering

witnesses.decoder: rtl_bit_model_fp64.py (fixed-width Python model of gf_decode_param_fp64.v) vs gf48_decode_ref.py golden
witnesses.note: Fixed-width datapath spec for the FP64 RTL. The iverilog run of gf_decode_param_fp64.v with tb_gf_decode_fp64.v is the stronger RTL-simulation witness prepared for the local agent (sandbox has no iverilog). Both fixed-width fixes (widen-before-shift; OOB-safe wide sub_shifted) carried over from the FP32 iverilog witness. SW/simulation-only; not Tier-E HW.
witnesses.scope: 224255 representative codes: 5-class + boundary + full-exponent stress sweep + deep-underflow edge + 200k deterministic random (2^48 exhaustive infeasible)
witnesses.source: gHashTag/t27 conformance/gf48 witness set (rtl_bit_model_fp64.py, gf_decode_param_fp64.v, tb_gf_decode_fp64.v)
